# League of Agents

> See every change your agents make. A map of your repo for Claude Code, Codex and Cursor. Select files or lines, give your agent a task, then review its changes.

## What it does

- Shows your repository as a map: folders and code files, zoomed out for the shape and in to read the code.
- Lets you select a file, a folder or exact lines and give your coding agent a task scoped to them.
- Records every change as a run, by an agent or by you, with before, after and diff, your checks' results, and one-click undo.
- Runs on your computer as a small local bridge; leagueofagents.dev talks to it from your browser.

League of Agents never uploads your code anywhere. Your code goes only to the agent you authorized.

## Install

In a git repository, on macOS with Node 20 or later:

```
npx leagueofagents-cli@latest
```

## Supported agents

- Claude Code
- Codex (beta)
- Cursor (beta)

Changes from any other editor show up as runs too.
